newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM sees significant improvement ops income.
newsitem.headline: KLM sees significant improvement ops income.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday it expected 1997/98 operating income to show a significant improvement.
"We expect for 1997/98 a significant improvement in operating income from the present unsatisfactory base," the airline said in a statement.

It said 1997/98 operating income depended on a number of factors such as the initial results of its Focus 2000 programme to cut costs and improve operating revenues, expectations of a continued positive economic climate and the likelyhood of lower fuel prices.
But it said another factor was ongoing pressure on yields.

KLM earlier reported 1996/97 net profit for the year ended March 31, 1997 nosedived to 236 million guilders after taking a one-off restructuring charge of 290 million guilders from 547 million in 1995/96.
